site_name: Land Known As Devonshire Place747-759 And 765-775 Old Kent Road And Land At Devonshire GroveLondonSE15 1NZ
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 23/AP/1862, which gave consent for:"Phased mixed-use redevelopment of the site, comprising:   -  Demolition of all existing buildings/structures, site clearance and excavation;  -  Construction of buildings to provide residential dwellings (Class C3) and flexible commercial, business and service space (Class E);  -  Construction of buildings to provide purpose built student accommodation including associated amenity and ancillary space, flexible commercial, business, service and community spaces within Classes E/F2(b) (Sui Generis); and  -  Provision of associated car and cycle parking, open space and landscaping, means of access and highway alterations, installation of plant and utilities and all other associated ancillary works incidental to the development)".The non-material amendments sought by 26/AP/0377 are:  -  Change of tenure of the 75 consented dwellings in Block C from Shared Ownership to Social Rent;  -  Relocation of the consented basement at Block A to Block B;  -  Re-sizing of the consented basement at Block D;  -  Changes to the size and layout of the internal communal amenity facilities, refuse stores, plant rooms and ancillary facilities in Block A and Block B;   -  Relocation, resizing and reconfiguration of the consented cycle facilities in Block A, Block B and Block D  -  Reconfiguration of the consented rooftops, affecting the rooftop plant areas, the shared communal amenity spaces, and the extent and nature of greening;  -  Redesign of the consented circulation cores within Block A, Block B, Block C and Block D;  -  Changes to the consented elevations (including small reductions in the overall height) of Block A, Block B, Block C and Block D;  -  Adjustments to the layouts of the consented Class C3 dwellings, including in some instances the associated balconies; and  -  Adjustments to the distribution of the consented wheelchair Class C3 dwellings.
